chapter.title: The Test Chapter
chapter.body:
The office was quiet. Rain tapped on the window in a slow, steady beat.

A folder sat on the desk. Someone had left it there, squared to the edge.

Inside was a single sheet of paper. The handwriting was small and very neat.

You read it twice. The second time, one word stood out.

One word was underlined twice. The word was [[lantern]], and it meant something.

You put the sheet back and closed the folder. Then you sat down to think.

The rain kept on. Somewhere below, a door opened and shut again.

clueTap.prompt: One word in the note is doing the work. Which is closest in meaning?
